name: STAR Assurance — CCSDS Space Packet decoder audit
summary: Differential audit of what CCSDS Space Packet decoders accept (spacepackets, ccsdspy, star_telemetry) on a pinned corpus of valid, idle and deliberately malformed packets; reference is the CCSDS 133.0-B packet rule.
reference: CCSDS 133.0-B Space Packet Protocol: version '000', 11-bit APID, 14-bit sequence count, packet data length = data octets - 1
reference_observed: a strict decoder written from the rule has 0 verdict errors; version-lenient, length-lenient and misreading decoders are scored exactly as constructed

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-06: corpus generated in-repo, fingerprint of the rounded corpus pinned
review.G-08: subprocess only for the audited decoder; buffers via stdin; runner names prefixed
review.G-13: failed run raises with stderr tail; a decoder that misreads a valid packet is not validated
